tools.name: fair_market_rent
tools.description: HUD Fair Market Rent and Small Area FMR for a US ZIP code, by bedroom count, with effective dates and source links. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Which data layers (federal, tax-credit, local agency) exist for a US ZIP code. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: rent_ceilings_for_unit
tools.description: Every rent ceiling for one unit: HUD FMR (free), plus tax-credit rent limits and the local agency payment standard where your plan includes them. Uses up to 2 calls of your plan. Paid parts are available on: PRO ($29/month, 5,000 calls), ULTRA ($99/month, 50,000 calls), MEGA ($299/month, 250,000 cal

tools.name: tax_credit_limits
tools.description: Tax-credit (LIHTC/MTSP) rent and income limits for a US ZIP code, all income tiers, with held-harmless limits by placed-in-service date. Available on: PRO ($29/month, 5,000 calls), ULTRA ($99/month, 50,000 calls), MEGA ($299/month, 250,000 calls). Needs your own Glazed Data API key in the x-api-key

tools.name: section8_income_limits
tools.description: HUD Section 8 income limits (30%, 50%, 80%) by household size for a US ZIP code. Available on: PRO ($29/month, 5,000 calls), ULTRA ($99/month, 50,000 calls), MEGA ($299/month, 250,000 calls). Needs your own Glazed Data API key in the x-api-key header (create one at https://glazeddata.com/rent-limits

tools.name: local_payment_standard
tools.description: The local housing agency's own voucher payment standard for a ZIP, with its effective date and source document. Available on: ULTRA ($99/month, 50,000 calls), MEGA ($299/month, 250,000 calls). Needs your own Glazed Data API key in the x-api-key header (create one at https://glazeddata.com/rent-limit

tools.name: voucher_headroom_and_renter_demand
tools.description: Voucher headroom against tax-credit rents and renter-household counts (HUD CHAS) for a ZIP. Available on: ULTRA ($99/month, 50,000 calls), MEGA ($299/month, 250,000 calls). Needs your own Glazed Data API key in the x-api-key header (create one at https://glazeddata.com/rent-limits/pricing/).
